name: How do I choose between a cash offer and a traditional financed offer for my condo?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a cash offer and a traditional financed offer for my condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a cash offer and a traditional financed offer involves weighing several factors. A cash offer typically provides faster closing and more certainty, but a financed offer might potentially yield a higher sale price. Consider your priorities: speed, maximum profit, or ease of process. Kelby Contreras helps compare these offers side-by-side, detailing the practical tradeoffs and benefits of each for your specific property in Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider speed, certainty, and potential sale price when choosing between cash and financed offers.
